description: 双兵对峙①：连通兵封锁 — d5+d6连通兵锁住黑方d7兵，白王奔袭g6

intro.popup_en: White's connected d-pawns on d5 and d6 blockade the black d-pawn. The black g6-pawn is isolated, so the white king can capture it and then promote the d-pawn.
intro.popup: 💡 连通兵封锁：白方 d5+d6 连通兵将黑 d7 兵死死封锁。黑方 g6 兵孤立无援，白王可轻松吃掉它，再推兵升变。

outro.popup_en: White wins. After the white king captures the isolated g-pawn, the d-pawn advances without obstruction.
outro.popup: ✅ 结论：白胜！ 白王吃掉 g6 后，d 兵无阻挡顺利升变。

moves.popup_en: 1. Kf2: the white king heads toward the g6-pawn.
moves.popup: 1.Kf2 — 白王出动，奔向 g6 兵。

moves.popup_en: 1...Kc3: the black king tries to interfere with the d-pawn.
moves.popup: 1...Kc3 — 黑王试图干扰 d 兵。

moves.popup_en: 2. Kg3: the white king continues its approach.
2...Kxd5? The black king captures the d5-pawn, but it is too late.
moves.popup: 2...Kxd5？ — 黑王吃掉 d5 兵，但为时已晚。

moves.popup_en: 3. Kxg6: the white king captures the isolated g-pawn.
moves.popup: 3.Kxg6 — 白王吃掉 g6 孤兵！

moves.popup_en: 3...Ke6: the black king has to turn back and try to stop the d-pawn.
moves.popup: 3...Ke6 — 黑王无奈，回头拦截 d 兵。

moves.popup_en: 4. d7: promotion is imminent, and Black cannot stop it.
moves.popup: 4.d7 — 升变在即，黑方无法阻挡！
